items.statement: For the explicitly submitted Tau-Im-2, Tau-Gly-2 and Tau-MEA-2 pose subset, validated BSSE/counterpoise interaction energies are compared and ordered using one consistent convention.
items.expected: The report identifies the three retained poses, gives finite signed interaction energies in kJ/mol, and derives the ordering from those submitted values. It does not claim to reproduce the paper's PM6-D3/MOPAC random-ensemble ordering or solution thermodynamics.

items.statement: The submitted pose-level interaction analysis may support a hydrogen-bond/dispersion interpretation only within the reported isolated-molecule model.
items.expected: Any structural interpretation is tied to the retained geometries and analysis; no claim is made about bulk extraction yield, solution populations or experimental separation.
